title: Diamond Elite Card: Understanding Your Annual Fee and Elite Benefits
summary: Explains the Diamond Elite Card’s $495.00 standard annual fee (appears on the first statement and each anniversary unless waived) and a related 15.99% interest rate on carried balances. Covers the invitation promotion: spend $50,000 within the promo period to waive the $495 fee and receive a $5,000 statement credit, plus what happens if the requirement isn’t met.
faqs: What is the Diamond Elite Card’s annual fee amount and when does it appear?
Under what conditions is the $495 annual fee waived?
How much is the invitation statement credit, and when will it post after qualification?
What happens if I don’t meet the $50,000 invitation spending requirement?
Does the annual fee relate to interest on carried balances, and what is the interest rate?
How can I verify that the fee waiver and $5,000 credit have posted correctly?
keywords: Annual fee waiver via invitation promo
